keep_features.feature_value: High density of political names (Sanders/Trump) and program names (IRA, Inflation Reduction Act, Tax Scam)
keep_features.evidence_span: "Bernie Sanders" ... "HEY BERNIE" ... "INFLATION REDUCTION ACT" ... "HEY TRUMP" ... "2017 TAX SCAM"
keep_features.rationale: The post repeatedly uses specific proper nouns and named legislation/program references.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct address + implied accountability challenge (HEY ... WHAT HAPPENED ...)
keep_features.evidence_span: "HEY BERNIE, WHAT HAPPENED TO THE TRILLION DOLLARS"
keep_features.rationale: It uses imperative-style rhetorical prompts directed at named individuals.
The subject is explicitly gun policy and self-defense laws.

keep_features.feature_value: Advocates removing militias (or not needing them) while contrasting past security forces
keep_features.rationale: The text contains an explicit prescriptive stance about security/militias.

keep_features.feature_value: Generalized belief in grifting/corruption across policies regardless of party/person
keep_features.evidence_span: "I just assume someone is grifting no matter what the policy is"
keep_features.rationale: It frames political actors as systematically corrupt/grifting rather than evaluating specific policies.
There is explicit taboo/profane language targeting political figures.

keep_features.feature_value: Children framed as harmed/persecuted due to lack of gun reform and officials dismissing them
keep_features.evidence_span: "school shootings" ... "elected officials thinking children are expendable"
keep_features.rationale: The post emphasizes harm to children and moral condemnation of officials.

keep_features.feature_value: Accuses a political group (left/left says) of hypocrisy and manipulative motives
keep_features.evidence_span: "The left says they care about children" ... "That's a lie."
keep_features.rationale: It sets up a polarized group-vs-“we” moral contrast and uses attribution of motives to the other side.

remove_features.feature_value: “Underbelly” metaphor and incendiary “burn this country down” phrasing
remove_features.rationale: It relies on metaphorical/hyperbolic framing of political groups as capable of destruction.

remove_features.feature_value: Derogatory insults about intelligence (low IQ / brain-dead)
remove_features.rationale: The language attacks groups via perceived cognitive deficiency terms.

remove_features.feature_value: All-caps campaign slogan text embedded in quotes
remove_features.evidence_span: "TRUMP WAS RIGHT ABOUT EVERYTHING" / "HARRIS WAS RIGHT ABOUT EVERYTHING"
remove_features.rationale: The post uses prominent all-caps slogan emphasis.

remove_features.feature_value: Laughing + contempt via “pathetic” and mock campaign framing
remove_features.rationale: It expresses ridicule directed at a political figure and their campaign behavior.

remove_features.feature_value: Insulting, dismissive language (morons/cowards) and challenge framing
remove_features.rationale: The register is highly derisive and informal with direct insult terms.

remove_features.feature_value: Not present; instead uses argumentative contrast and allegations of electoral manipulation
remove_features.evidence_span: "It's so weird that Democrats will... but will say third party voters..."
remove_features.rationale: The structure uses a contrastive comparison (“but”) to support the claim of hypocrisy.

remove_features.feature_value: Explicit contrast: split vote vs claiming third-party subversion
remove_features.evidence_span: "But" "It's like they're completely full of shit."
remove_features.rationale: It uses “but” to set up hypocrisy via opposing behaviors/claims.
The post discusses border/immigration enforcement and ICE actions.
